description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 24.04.2017 to 30.04.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and contains regulatory content about the determination of exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a legal/regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs exercising powers vested by statute, making it a clear example of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
